title: Neothesia: free Synthesia alternative
caption:
Synthesia costs $39 to learn piano songs from falling notes. Neothesia does it for free 🎹

✅ Turns any MIDI song into colorful falling notes on a virtual piano
✅ Plug in a MIDI keyboard and play along
✅ Choose a track to mute, auto-play or play yourself
✅ Slow the song down and rewind while you practice

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ You bring your own MIDI files (no built-in song library), and playing along needs a MIDI keyboard. On Mac, right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Synthesia's regular price is $39 (it's sometimes on sale)

Comment "PIANO" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
